title: Faithful flat descent for a line bundle whose pullback is trivial: the sections form invertible modules and multiply isomorphically
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a faithfully flat ring map A -> B and a quasi-compact quasi-separated A-scheme X, a line bundle on X whose pullback to X_B is trivial has globally invertible modules of sections in both directions, and the multiplication map between them is an isomorphism. The proof lets M and R be the modules of sections of L and of O_X, computes H^0(X_B, L_B) as M tensor_A B by flat base change, identifies it with R tensor_A B because the pullback of L is trivial, and concludes that M is invertible over R by faithful flat descent for finite projective modules (proof lines 5757-5780). H2: the descent step and the tensor-product comparison are the substance, and both are written out.
